title: ProgressIndicator
description: An indeterminate loading indicator for operations of unknown duration.

types.title: Types
types.description: Spinner (default), circle, wave, bar and dotted bar.

width.title: Width
width.description: Set a fixed width, or use full to fill the container.

with-icon.title: With icon
with-icon.description: Show an icon before the indicator. Always describe what is loading with ariaLabel.

ProgressIndicatorProps.ariaLabel: Accessible label describing what is loading
ProgressIndicatorProps.width: Custom width (ignored when full is set)
ProgressIndicatorProps.full: Stretches the indicator to the full width of its container
